propositions: Batched overlap-judge calls inherit generic 16,000-token and 600-second budgets without operation-local bounds, causing up to three structured generations and 200+ second latency on malformed candidate_id responses.
RunRequest lacks lowering-only seams for output-token limit, structured-retry count, transport-attempt count, and request timeout before model/provider construction.
Token cap alone does not prevent retried generations; schema validation alone does not prevent oversized payloads from being constructed, requiring explicit retry-count bounds.
Overlap-judge must degrade malformed responses, truncation, and timeout to exact all-candidate abstention within documented advisory-only intent.
Request-local budgets (1,024 output tokens, one structured attempt, one transport attempt, 60-second timeout) must be enforced in both native and prompted structured paths.
Existing callers omitting request-local limits must retain current global defaults; containment changes are lowering-only with no effect on valid verdicts or aggregation behavior.
